The numerical process reads no raw figure, PDF pixel, digitized curve, author code, author numerical array, or network resource.
All 35 frozen implementation-closure items are emitted with explicit target mappings and passing implementation status.
Cylinder spectra, open-boundary phase scans, square dynamics, disk gap scaling, S4 scans, and exact-cylinder checks execute from the declared Hamiltonians.
The triangle path accepts an explicit site geometry and records the unpublished paper geometry as an input boundary instead of guessing it.
Reduced execution, reconstructed finite-size protocols, and missing publication inputs never change scientific coverage; no raw figure, source pixel, author array, or author code is read.
Main Fig. 2 and Fig. 3(b) execute at caption scale with quantitative gap, normalization, motion, branch and resolution checks.
Fig. 3(a), S4, S8 and S9 use independent analytic, invariant and convergence checks without source-figure numeric input.
T012 executes a representative triangle kernel but preserves the missing publication geometry as an explicit source-audited input boundary.
The isolated runner reads every declared code/config input and no paper, reference pixel, author code, or author array.
